title: Leakdown and compression test, record per cylinder

notices.text: Warm engine, all plugs out, throttle propped open. Record both absolute numbers and cylinder-to-cylinder spread — spread matters more than absolute. Listen at the oil filler (rings), the intake (intake valve), the exhaust (exhaust valve) and the coolant tank (head gasket / D-chunk crack). Bubbles in the expansion tank during leakdown on one specific cylinder is the classic D-chunk / cracked-liner tell. Write the numbers on the build sheet; they are your before/after proof.
